scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/db --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker --noEmit && tsc -b apps/web --force
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
